doc.title: Incoming Inspection of Packaging Materials
doc.file: QP-308 Incoming Inspection of Packaging Materials.pdf
doc.purpose: Stop bad bottles, caps, labels and cases at the dock, before they reach a line.

roles.name: QA Technician
roles.does: Inspects and releases or rejects each lot.

roles.name: Receiving Clerk
roles.does: Holds the delivery in quarantine until release.

references.as_written: QP-309 Packaging Material Specifications and Approved Suppliers

parameters.quote: Bottles (sample of 13): weight, height, neck finish with the go/no-go gauge, no flash or contamination.
Caps (sample of 13): size, colour, liner present, fit on a sample bottle.
Labels (3 rolls per lot): artwork and revision against the binder
Shipper cases (sample of 5): dimensions, board grade stamp, print.
core diameter 76 mm, labels wound outward

parameters.what: time to email Purchasing after a failed lot
parameters.quote: Fail: red REJECTED tag, hold as described in QP-315, and email Purchasing the same day.

rules.statement: The QA Technician releases or rejects each lot.
rules.quote: Pass: green RELEASED sticker on every pallet or roll.

rules.topic: which suppliers' packaging may be used
rules.statement: The QA Technician rejects a lot whose supplier is not on the approved list in QP-309.
rules.quote: Check the supplier is on the approved list in QP-309. If not, reject.

unsure.what: Label checks do not list liner caliper
unsure.why: QP-309 Rev G (later than this Rev D) makes label liner caliper a critical characteristic on every lot; this document is not updated for it
